lines.en: Scales shine as it moves through mist
Cold eyes glide by
Tail swishes, getting closer
Sword glints, silently
Chilling presence, silent steps
Frosty blade, always following
Mist-shrouded form, elusive
Sword flash, close by
Frosty blade, silent threat
Mist swirls, sword dances
Ripples slide along my blade.

lines.zh: 踏着雾，我走向下个对手。
lines.en: Treading mist, I go to the next foe.
Standing in mist, silent
Staring intently in all directions
Graceful hops among the mist
Staring into the abyss, sword heart like water
Patiently waiting, ready to strike
Whispers, chilling the air
Sword tip trembles, releasing energy
Patiently waiting, eyes cold
Sword dances, heart calm
Staring ahead, sword pointing nowhere
Detecting prey, eyes fixed
Staring intently at you
Chilling gaze, focused on you
Sword glints, heart like fire
Cold eyes, staring at you
Sword tip moves, energy pressing
Sharp gaze, locked on target
Frosty blade, in the gaze
Sword shadow appears, staring at you
Sword tip pointed, chilling light
Severely wounded!
Blood keeps flowing, I press my side.
Severely hurt!

lines.zh: 水之呼吸的刀势还没断。
lines.en: My Water Breathing form is not finished.
Serious injury!
Dying fast!
Critical condition!
Wound infected!
Cut badly!
Severely hurt, almost gone!

lines.zh: 我闻到你的食物了，准备好战斗吧。
lines.en: I smell your food. Prepare for battle.

lines.zh: 别想逃，你的味道真不错。
lines.en: Don't try to run. You taste good.

lines.zh: 你身上有我弟子的味道。
lines.en: You smell like my disciple.
The food on you draws me in.

lines.zh: 战斗之前先品尝你的味道。
lines.en: Sample your taste before the fight.

lines.zh: 我的剑会割裂你的皮肉。
lines.en: My sword will slice your skin.

lines.zh: 你身上的污秽让我兴奋。
lines.en: The filth on you excites me.

lines.zh: 跟我战斗，享受战斗的乐趣。
lines.en: Fight me, enjoy the battle.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道告诉我，你很适合战斗。
lines.en: Your scent tells me you're good for a fight.

lines.zh: 我的剑已经迫不及待了。
lines.en: My sword can't wait.

lines.zh: 我们撞上了，准备好战斗。
lines.en: We collided. Prepare for battle.

lines.zh: 我们相撞了，战斗在所难免。
lines.en: We collided. Battle is inevitable.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的道路，准备好战斗。
lines.en: You blocked my path. Prepare for battle.

lines.zh: 我们撞到了一起，战斗开始吧。
lines.en: We collided. Let the battle begin.
In the mist of Sagiri Mountain, do not block the way.

lines.zh: 我们撞到了一起，现在战斗吧。
lines.en: We collided. Now fight.
You obstructed my movement.

lines.zh: 我们撞上了，战斗已经开始了。
lines.en: We collided. Battle has begun.
No expression behind this mask.

lines.zh: 我们撞到了一起，战斗开始。
lines.en: We collided. Battle starts.

lines.zh: 找到你，我的战斗变得更有趣了。
lines.en: Finding you makes the battle more interesting.

lines.zh: 我们来战斗吧，你让我很兴奋。
lines.en: Let's fight. You excite me.

lines.zh: 你让我找到了战斗的乐趣。
lines.en: You gave me a reason to fight.

lines.zh: 找到你，战斗变得更有意义。
lines.en: Finding you makes the battle更有意义.

lines.zh: 你让我有了战斗的动力。
lines.en: You gave me a reason to fight.

lines.zh: 与你战斗，我找到了乐趣。
lines.en: Fighting you, I found乐趣.

lines.zh: 你的存在让战斗更有意义。
lines.en: Your presence makes the battle更有意义.
Fighting you, I feel excitement.

lines.zh: 你让我找到了战斗的意义。
lines.en: You gave me a purpose in battle.

lines.zh: 战斗有了你，变得更有意义。
lines.en: The battle has purpose with you.

lines.zh: 我感受到你的力量，准备好了吗？
lines.en: Feel my power, are you ready?

lines.zh: 鳞泷的剑技，你准备好接了吗？
lines.en: Saber technique of Rin, ready to receive?
Come on, show me your strength!

lines.zh: 你的食物，也是我的食粮。
lines.en: Your food, my sustenance.

lines.zh: 在这狭雾山中，你无处可逃。
lines.en: In this Misty Mountain, nowhere to hide.
I am Sabito, your opponent.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我替你收好。
lines.en: I will keep what you dropped safe.

lines.zh: 我的剑，是水之呼吸的化身。
lines.en: My sword is the manifestation of Water Breathing.
I will keep this water for the road.
Fight to the death.
My blade is drawn; you move first.

lines.zh: 寻找我的弟子，开始行动！
lines.en: Find my disciple, let's move!
Wicked spirits, nowhere to run.

lines.zh: 感受我的呼吸，尝尝我的剑吧。
lines.en: Feel my breath, taste my sword.
You cannot escape my sight.
Your end is near.

lines.zh: 在这片山中，你无所遁形。
lines.en: In this mountain, nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 猎物，我的猎物，我的一切。
lines.en: Prey, my prey, my everything.

lines.zh: 在这片土地上，我就是王。
lines.en: On this land, I am king.
I know a demon's smell clearly.
A demon's stench. Hard to miss.

lines.zh: 这一刀算是替师父试你。
lines.en: This cut tests you for my master.
The wind of Mt. Sagiri told me.
I died once. I do not fear dying again.
Steady your breath, and the sword stays true.
My sword is aimed at you.
Ready? My sword.

lines.zh: 我将用我的剑，结束你的生命。
lines.en: I will end your life with my sword.
The shadow of death, falls over you.
My sword, the messenger of death.

lines.zh: 水之呼吸，一刀接着一刀。
lines.en: Water Breathing, one cut after another.

lines.zh: 你的终结，就在我的剑尖。
lines.en: Your end is at my sword tip.
My sword, the blade of death.

lines.zh: 狭雾山的雾，先凉到骨头。
lines.en: Sagiri mist chills you to the bone first.
Death is within reach.
The form is steady; my feet must not slip.
My blade travels from low to high.

lines.zh: 你的重心偏了，左肩开口。
lines.en: Your balance is off, your left shoulder is open.
You cannot see my blade in the mist.
Do not rush. I will let you strike first.
Your footwork is wrong. You have lost.
This move, Urokodaki taught me.
My edge aligns with your neck.
Water Breathing begins at my feet.
My tip is steady, and so is my heart.
Water Breathing, Second Form: lateral cut.
Holding water blade, fight!
Layer River Breath, break the enemy!
Silver hare fangs, bite hard!
Sword light like water, slash!
Frost light, attack!
Out in the mist, quick battle!
Icicles, cold sword tip!
Water sword shadow, quick attack!
Mist attack, fatal strike!
Water Surface Slash, fall!
Horizontal Waterwheel, spin!
You were half a beat late.

lines.zh: 这一剑收得住，你收不住。
lines.en: I can stop my blade. You cannot stop yours.
The mist clears. The blade remains.
Slaying demons leaves no room for mercy.
Your breathing broke. You lost.
I never turn my back on a foe.
Born in cold mist, icy body!
Born in Narrow Mist Mountain, new Sabito!
Appearing in mist, battle begins!
I am Sabito, covered in ice!
Born on Narrow Mist Mountain, Sabito's son!

lines.zh: 寒冰中孵化，战斗永不停息！
lines.en: Hatched in ice, battle never ends!
Born in cold wind, frost blade out!
Appearing in mist shadow, ready for battle!
Ice land, Sabito's spirit!
Narrow Mist Mountain top, ice spirit!
The mist gathers. The blade lands first.
Sabito, back from Mt. Sagiri.
I grip my sword and open my eyes.
Beneath the fox mask, I live again.

lines.zh: 火光晃眼，我的刀慢了半拍。
lines.en: The firelight blinds me; my blade lags half a beat.

lines.zh: 从崖上摔下去，我的面具磕裂了。
lines.en: I fell from the cliff and my mask cracked.
Drowned, almost out of breath!

lines.zh: 气浪把我的水纹吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters my water ripples.
Hit by projectile!

lines.zh: 水之呼吸挡不住这一下。
lines.en: Water breathing can't block this.
On an empty stomach I cannot swing my blade.

lines.zh: 水雾散开，雷还是落下来。
lines.en: The mist cleared, and the lightning still found me.
Fell into the void, in pain!
